dialogue.title: चहा ऑर्डर करणे संवाद

parts.speaker: npc
parts.marathi: नमस्कार! आजका मौसम ठंडक आहे, कसर एक कप त foremost cutting chai?
parts.transliteration: Namaskār! Ājkā mausam ṭhank āhe, kasar ek kap tēvha cutting chai?
parts.english: Hello! The weather is cool today, would you like a cup of hot cutting chai?
parts.pronunciationTip: Stress the 'taa' in 'cutting' and the long 'aa' in 'chai'
parts.grammarNote: Kasar = how about/may I suggest (polite suggestion)

options.text: होय, कृपया एक कप cutting chai
options.transliteration: Hoy, kripayā ek kap cutting chai
options.translation: Yes, please one cup cutting chai

options.hint: तुमच्यासाठी कधी तरी गर्म पाणी उपलब्ध आहे
options.hintTranslation: Hot water is also available for you

parts.speaker: npc
parts.marathi: शाबाश! तुमच्याशी पहिल्यांदा भेटवलो आहे. एक cutting chai वाढा रुपये.
parts.transliteration: Śubhāś! Tumcyāśī pahilyāṇḍā bhētalō āhe. Ek cutting chāhā vāḍhā rūpiye.
parts.english: Excellent! It's nice meeting you for the first time. One cutting chai will be extra rupee.
parts.pronunciationTip: Say 'vaddha' with stress on the first syllable
parts.grammarNote: Vadhā = more/additional, common in Mumbai-Pune area for extra charge

options.hint: त्याचा अर्थ hegemonic extra one rupee

parts.speaker: npc
parts.marathi: आजची विशेषत: रवीunday चहा विशेष मसाला मिश्रण आहे. स्वाद व croissance का अनुभव चार
parts.transliteration: Ājīcī viśeṣat: Ravivār chāhā viśeṣ masālā miśraṇ āhe. Svādu prayōg kānubhav cāhī
parts.english: Today's special: Sunday chai with special masala blend. You'll experience taste growth fourfold
parts.pronunciationTip: Say 'vishesh' clearly, stress on second syllable
parts.grammarNote: Special weekend masala mix mentioned - cultural context

parts.speaker: npc
parts.marathi: आनंदा वघे! तुमचं स्वागत आहे. सुटे पाणी available.
parts.transliteration: Ānandā vaghe! Tumcha swāgat āhe. Suṭe pāṇī available.
parts.english: Enjoy it well! You're welcome. Plain water also available.
parts.grammarNote: Idiomatic expression for enjoying food/drink thoroughly

culturalNotes: Cutting chai is a Pune/Mumbai specialty - strong tea served in small glasses
The 'cutting' refers to cutting a full glass into two halves
Street tea culture is integral to daily life in Maharashtra
Sunday special chai often has extra ginger, cardamom, and lemongrass
dialogue.completionMessage: आपण माराठीत cutting chai आर्डर करणे सीखть! पुणे विशिष्ट चाय संस्कृतिचा अनुभव मिळवले.
